title: Cancellation of completion units in mixed rational realization diagrams
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime and $E\subset L$ finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with valuation rings $A_F=\mathcal O_F$ and chosen uniformizers $t_F$ for $F=E,L$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible. On its small pro-etale site put $B_{F,X}=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A_F/t_F^n)_X$ and $F_X=B_{F,X}[1/t_F]$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Use sheaves of modules, sheaf tensor products and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $\mathcal C_F(X)=D^b_c(X,A_F)$ for the completed integral category with compatible etale-origin witnesses, $Q_F:\mathcal C_F(X)\to\mathcal R_F(X)=\mathcal C_F(X)[1/t_F]$ for raw rationalization [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete, def-weil-pbc-rational-category], and $J_{F,X}(Q_FK)=F_X\otimes^L_{B_{F,X}}K$, $J_{F,X}(f/t_F^n)=t_F^{-n}(F_X\otimes^L f)$ [lem-per-rational-module-realization-functor]. Let $C_X=B_{L,X}\otimes^L_{B_{E,X}}-$, with constructible restriction and raw rationalization $T_{L/E,X}$ [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension].

Let $g:X'\to X$ be a scheme map between schemes with the stated hypotheses; form all coefficients and functors on $X'$ likewise. Put $P_{F,g}=B_{F,X'}\otimes^L_{g^{-1}B_{F,X}}g^{-1}(-)$ and $H_{F,g}=F_{X'}\otimes^L_{g^{-1}F_X}g^{-1}(-)$. Write $\widehat P_{F,g}$ and $\gamma_{F,g}:P_{F,g}\to\widehat P_{F,g}$ for the specified quotient completed pullback and unit [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Use the comparison $\theta=t^{-1}s$ with its fraction and coefficient-tower normalization [lem-per-rational-scalar-balanced-localization], and $\beta_g,\widehat\beta_g$ with the actual unit equation and pasting laws [lem-per-rational-scalar-completion-unit-square]. Let $\alpha_{F,g}:J_{F,X'}Q_F\widehat P_{F,g}\xrightarrow{\sim}H_{F,g}J_{F,X}Q_F$ be the specific comparison of [lem-per-rational-realization-pullback-comparison]: it is $J_{F,X'}Q_F(\gamma_{F,g}^{-1})$ followed by ordinary balanced localization. The localization/inverse-image identification is the canonical unit-preserving $g^{-1}F_X\cong(g^{-1}B_{F,X})[1/t_F]$ [lem-weil-pbc-localization-inverse-image-coherence].

Write $D_W=L_W\otimes^L_{E_W}-$, and let $\zeta_g:D_{X'}H_{E,g}\xrightarrow{\sim}H_{L,g}D_X$ be ordinary balanced scalar/pullback. For every $K\in\mathcal C_E(X)$ there is an equality of derived morphisms
$$\zeta_{g,J_{E,X}Q_EK}\,D_{X'}(\alpha_{E,g,K})\,\theta_{X',\widehat P_{E,g}K}
=H_{L,g}(\theta_{X,K})\,\alpha_{L,g,C_XK}\,J_{L,X'}Q_L(\widehat\beta_{g,K}).$$
Both sides start at $J_{L,X'}Q_L(C_{X'}\widehat P_{E,g}K)$ and end at $H_{L,g}D_XJ_{E,X}Q_EK$. Precomposition by the isomorphism $J_{L,X'}Q_L(C_{X'}\gamma_{E,g,K})$ identifies both sides with the same ordinary balanced map through $L_{X'}\otimes^L_{g^{-1}B_{E,X}}g^{-1}K$. On simultaneous flat-term K-flat presentations, before flattening, its local tensor formula is $l'\otimes b'\otimes p\mapsto l'i_{X'}(b')\otimes p$; the coefficient actions are those of the finite-projection square, and the formula commutes with every site restriction. Thus this assertion concerns the specified $\alpha$'s and completion-unit maps.

These equalities are natural on the raw rational categories, including fraction morphisms. They commute with identity and composition of scheme maps, using the canonical inverse-image compositors and the ambient derived pullback composition comparisons, and with successive coefficient extensions and their specified scalar associators. Under the reflected-unit equation, substituting $\alpha_{F,g}=({\rm ordinary\ balancing})J_FQ_F(\gamma_{F,g}^{-1})$ in these pasting diagrams identifies them with the ordinary tensor diagrams, with every adjacent inverse-unit/unit pair cancelling. Their remaining values for two geometric maps are scalar insertion and multiplication after the canonical inverse-image compositor, and for three coefficient scalars are their product acting on the pulled-back representative, independently of parentheses. The identity diagrams, the four-field pentagon and their mixed pasting equations use these same comparisons, not unrelated isomorphisms of the endpoints.

proof.text:
Write $R_{F,W}=J_{F,W}Q_F$, and let $a_{F,g}:R_{F,X'}P_{F,g}\to H_{F,g}R_{F,X}$ be ordinary balanced localization. The specified pullback comparison says $\alpha_{F,g}=a_{F,g}R_{F,X'}(\gamma_{F,g}^{-1})$. Ordinary pullback of a constructible integral object is still constructible and its actual $\gamma$ is invertible. Scalar extension preserves these objects. Consequently
$$w_K=R_{L,X'}(C_{X'}\gamma_{E,g,K})$$
is an isomorphism in the source of the asserted equality. The completion-square statement supplies, for these very units and comparisons,
$$\widehat\beta_g C_{X'}\gamma_{E,g}=\gamma_{L,g}C_X\,\beta_g.$$
Here $\gamma_{L,g}C_X$ denotes evaluation at $C_XK$, not a different completion map.

proof.text:
Denote the displayed left and right sides of the item by $A_K$ and $B_K$. Naturality of $\theta$ for $\gamma_E$ gives
$$A_Kw_K=\zeta_gD_{X'}(a_{E,g,K})\theta_{X',P_{E,g}K}.$$
Indeed, move $w_K$ across $\theta$ and cancel $R_E(\gamma_E^{-1})R_E(\gamma_E)$. Apply $R_L$ to the actual unit equation from Step 1 and then use $\alpha_LR_L(\gamma_L)=a_L$ to obtain
$$B_Kw_K=H_{L,g}(\theta_{X,K})a_{L,g,C_XK}R_{L,X'}(\beta_{g,K}).$$
These are substitutions in natural transformations and cancellation of inverses; they retain the originally specified $\widehat\beta$, $\alpha$, and $\gamma$. Lean companion rationalMixedUnitPrecomposition_eq realizes this step for a supplied mixed comparison: specialize the realization fraction formula to denominator one, apply alpha_normalization, and use naturality of theta. The right-route formula then follows from the supplied compatibility equation. Invertibility follows from unit_isIso and preservation by all three functors.

proof.text:
Compare the two ordinary expressions in Step 2. Choose a flat-term K-flat representative $P$ of $K$. Ringed-topos pullback preserves this class, including scalar extension (the identity geometric morphism), so all the comparisons can be computed on this same presentation. Use the unit-preserving identification $g^{-1}E_X=(g^{-1}B_{E,X})[1/t_E]$. The normalized $s,t$, the ordinary $a$'s and $\zeta$ are tensor composition comparisons. Flattening their common target identifies it with $L_{X'}\otimes^L_{g^{-1}B_{E,X}}g^{-1}K$. On their common source, after removing the adjacent $B_{L,X'}$ factor, both expressions send
$$l'\otimes b'\otimes p\longmapsto l'i_{X'}(b')\otimes p.$$
Balancing over $g^{-1}B_{E,X}$ holds because $i_{X'}c_{E,g}=c_{L,g}g^{-1}i_X$. The coefficient factors have degree zero, so these maps commute with the differential without a sign. They commute with restrictions because the structural maps are sheaf maps. Thus the maps of sheafified tensor complexes coincide. The representative-defined natural comparisons descend this equality to the derived category. Step 2 now gives $A_Kw_K=B_Kw_K$, and cancelling the isomorphism $w_K$ proves the asserted equation and its stated precomposition formula. The companion rationalMixedOrdinarySections follows from ordinary_units: apply the inverse ordinary comparison, then use linearity and the normalized scalar-adjunction unit to move b through the tensor. The companion rationalMixedCommonTensor uses the precomposition formula; naturality of zeta moves the realization object transport, inverse factors cancel, and the defining theta = s followed by inverse t gives exactly s.

proof.text: Every transformation used above is natural on integral derived morphisms. On $f/t_E^n$ its realization is the integral map multiplied by $t_E^{-n}$; the scalar images are invertible constants in $L$ and remain so after inverse image. Thus the same naturality equations hold after multiplying by that inverse scalar. If two fractions agree via $t_E^r(t_E^mf-t_E^nh)=0$, apply the integral functors to this equation and multiply by $t_E^{-r-m-n}$: their realized images agree. This is precisely the fraction relation supplied by balanced localization and the object/fraction formula for $J$. Consequently the equality is one of natural transformations on the raw rational categories, even when integral Hom groups have torsion. The companion rationalMixedRawNaturality is proved directly as naturality of the composite of whiskered theta, alpha and zeta. Its formula is on every raw morphism, so it includes all fractions without a separate torsion cancellation hypothesis; compatibility transfers the formula to the right route.

proof.text:
For $X''\xrightarrow hX'\xrightarrow gX$, first consider ordinary pullbacks. Their composition comparison is the representative-defined scalar-insertion comparison, and it is monoidal. The inverse-image localization identification has exactly the same composition normalization, and the localized ordinary-pullback normalization gives $\delta_{g\circ h}F(a)=b\,G_h(\delta_g)\,\delta_h$ for each coefficient field, with this representative formula. After the inverse-image compositor, the two flattenings of a local representative $l''\otimes l'\otimes p$ both have value
$$l''c_{L,h}(h^{-1}l')\otimes p.$$
Here $p$ is regarded in $(gh)^{-1}P$ by that compositor and $c_{L,h}$ denotes its localized coefficient map. Inserting an additional integral coefficient replaces $l'$ by $l'i(b')$ on both paths; the finite-projection square makes the actions agree. Thus the ordinary mixed squares commute with geometric composition. For the identity geometric map the same computation is the multiplication unitor. These computations concern the canonical ambient comparison: the monoidal-comparison statement specifies it on flat-term K-flat complexes, rather than merely asserting existence of an endpoint isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 0G7E (lemma-pullback-K-flat), 0D6D (lemma-derived-pullback-composition), 07A4 (lemma-pullback-tensor-product); explicit balancing and pasting calculation

proof.text: The completed pasting comparisons have the same normalization: the completed compositor and identity satisfy $\widehat a\,\gamma_h P_h(\gamma_g)=\gamma_{g\circ h}a$ and $\widehat e\gamma_{\rm id}=e$ by the quotient-completed compositor lemma, and for each field the $\alpha$'s paste along $g\circ h$ and the identity by the rational pullback composition coherence. In the reflected-adjunction construction the Hom bijection is precomposition with the reflection unit followed by the ordinary adjunct; hence a comparison to a complete target is determined by its composite with that unit. Its stated pasting law therefore identifies the composite pullback comparison with the ordinary one conjugated by the units. On our constructible objects all these units are invertible. Substitute $\alpha=aR(\gamma^{-1})$ in a pasted diagram, use $R(\widehat\beta)R(C\gamma_E)=R(\gamma_L)R(\beta)$ at each mixed square, and cancel each adjacent $R(\gamma^{-1})R(\gamma)$. For two consecutive cells this is the elementary identity $(v_2f_2v_1^{-1})(v_1f_1v_0^{-1})=v_2f_2f_1v_0^{-1}$. Thus the two geometric pastings and the identity diagrams reduce to the ordinary equations of Step 5. The completion-square statement identifies its reflected construction with the actual quotient-normalized scalar comparison and supplies its geometric pasting law, so no newly chosen completed comparison has entered.

proof.text: For $E\subset L\subset M$, balanced localization already identifies successive $\theta$'s with the specified raw scalar associator by $m\otimes l\otimes p\mapsto ml\otimes p$. The completion-square comparisons obey coefficient-tower pasting. Apply Step 6 to remove the units in a diagram containing both coefficient extensions and geometric maps. After the inverse-image compositors, every remaining coefficient is mapped into the final coefficient sheaf and multiplied there. Three scalar factors have value $nml$ on the pulled-back representative: $(nm)l=n(ml)$, independent of parentheses. Hence every face of the four-field pentagon and either order of mixed pasting has the same flattened map. For equality fields the raw scalar functor is literally the identity and its comparison is the multiplication unitor. The geometric identity case is Step 5. Reinsert the same outer units; the internal pairs cancel as in Step 6. This proves the coefficient, geometric and mixed coherence assertions for these specific comparisons. Step 4 carries all these equations to fractions. The rationalMixedPentagon companion has a shorter categorical proof: pbcReductionNormalization is the leftAdjointCompIso of the specified normalized derived adjunctions and restriction compositor. The ordinary restriction compositors are identity on sections, so their cocycle holds; mapDerivedCategoryCompNatIso_cocycle transports it to exact derived restriction. Mathlib leftAdjointCompIso_assoc gives the coefficient pentagon, and postcomposing with the identical zeta component proves the displayed mixed equation. No independent tensor-representative calculation is needed for this companion. The raw coefficient-tower companion has a direct proof from the published reflected coefficient-tower law. Invert that law and conjugate through the quotient-unit-normalized ambient pullback isomorphisms; their naturality and the ambient scalar associator cancel the intermediate inverse/hom pair. This gives the strict-beta tower law on all ambient inputs. Specialize the raw scalar and raw pullback fraction formulas to denominator one. Substitute beta_normalization and the specified rational scalar associator. Naturality of the latter moves the initial object transport, and all other recorded transports cancel. Apply the actual rationalization functor to the strict integral tower equation to obtain rationalMixedRawCoefficientTower without any new assumption or representative calculation.
